tools.name: find_creator
tools.description: Find creators on lookmybio by username or name. Returns their bio page links. Use it when someone asks for a creator’s link in bio, website or socials and you do not know their exact lookmybio username.

tools.name: get_bio_page
tools.description: Read a creator’s lookmybio bio page: name, bio, links and the blocks on the page, exactly as visitors see it. Link people to the page URL.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List the published posts on a creator’s lookmybio blog, newest first, with links. Use get_blog_post to read one.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Read one post from a creator’s lookmybio blog as plain text, by its slug (the last part of the post URL).

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Search the lookmybio help center and docs for how lookmybio works: features, plans and credits, billing, connecting social accounts, scheduling, the bio page, AI Studio, connecting AI apps, and fixing problems. Use it before answering any question about how to do something in lookmybio, and answer f

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_help" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the lookmybio help center and docs for how lookmybio works: features, plans and credits, billing, connecting social accounts, scheduling, the bio page, A…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_bio_page, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post, search_help · Public sink: get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_bio_page, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post, search_help · Public sink: get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
